title: Root-Knot Nematode Egg Extraction
author: Damaris Godinez-Vidal
materials: Blend or shake the roots for 3 mins.

steps.title: Prepare Work Area and Equipment
steps.instruction: Clean the workspace and all necessary equipment using hot tap water.

substeps.instruction: Wash around the sink with hot tap water and lay brown paper towels on both sides of the sink to cover the work area.
Wash the plastic buckets, three sieves, graduated cylinder, and scissors using hot tap water.

steps.title: Clean Infected Plant Roots
steps.instruction: Remove plant tops and thoroughly clean the roots of soil.

substeps.instruction: Cut off the tops (leaves, branches, and main stem) of the infected plants.
Wash roots by dipping them in a plastic bucket full of water.
Rinse roots in a second plastic bucket full of water until all soil particles are removed.
Cut the clean roots with scissors and remove any remaining main plant stem.

steps.title: Prepare 10% Bleach Solution
steps.instruction: Create a 10% bleach solution using a graduated cylinder.

substeps.instruction: Pour 100 mL of bleach into the graduated cylinder.
Add water to reach a final volume of 1,000 mL.

steps.title: Bleach Root Material
steps.instruction: Treat the roots with the bleach solution in a blender or shaker.

substeps.instruction: Place the roots of approximately one plant into a clean blender or shaker.
Cover the roots entirely with 10% bleach (approximately 350 mL to 1 L).

steps.title: Set Up Sieve Stack
steps.instruction: Arrange the sieves on a plastic bucket in the specified order.

substeps.instruction: Place the two 500-mesh sieves at the bottom.
Place the 170-mesh sieve at the top.

steps.title: Filter and Rinse Root Material
steps.instruction: Filter the treated roots through the sieve stack and remove bleach.

substeps.instruction: Pour the blended or shaken roots into the top sieve (170-mesh).
Rinse with tap water until the white bleach has disappeared.
Gently hit the sides of the sieves with a mallet to prevent pores from clogging.
Discard the plant material collected in the top sieve.

steps.title: Collect Eggs from Second Sieve
steps.instruction: Recover eggs from the first 500-mesh sieve.

substeps.instruction: Rinse debris in the second sieve (500-mesh) until all bleach has disappeared.
Gently gather the root-knot nematode eggs on one side of the sieve.
Use a wash bottle with tap water to collect the eggs into a clean plastic beaker.

steps.title: Collect Eggs from Final Sieve
steps.instruction: Recover eggs from the last 500-mesh sieve.

substeps.instruction: Gently rinse fine debris in the last 500-mesh sieve until all bleach has disappeared.
Carefully gather the eggs on one side of the sieve to ensure none are lost through the screen.
Use the wash bottle to collect the eggs into the plastic beaker.

steps.title: Recover Escaped Eggs
steps.instruction: Filter the remaining water to capture any missed eggs.

substeps.instruction: Pass the water collected in the plastic bucket through the bottom 500-mesh sieve.
Gather the nematode eggs and collect them in a different plastic beaker.
If the egg suspension is clean (no visible soil particles), combine both egg suspensions into the same beaker for quantification.

steps.title: Process Remaining Material
steps.instruction: Repeat the entire process until all root material has been processed.
